items.item_text: Ph.D. or M.S. in mathematics education, mathematics, statistics, or a close-related field
Teach courses as described and assigned per the expertise of the adjunct faculty
Discuss class progress with the program coordinator, including teaching performance through observation
Collaborate with other faculty as needed
Demonstrate a commitment to serving and inspiring students in an academic context that integrates your Christian faith and learning.

Embrace the mission, vision , and values of Fresno Pacific University, affirm the FPU Faith Expectations (Download PDF reader) , and support the ideals and practices articulated in " The Fresno Pacific Idea (Download PDF reader) ”
Commitment to the Christian faith and the University’s mission of Christ-centered teaching and learning and involvement in a local church.
Online via zoom between 2 to 4 hours at scheduled times.
Frequent computer use at a workstation, up to eight hours per day.
Frequently work at a fast pace with unscheduled interruptions.
Public online contact position requiring professional apparel and grooming.
This position typically functions on zoom and requires a strong internet connection.
The position may involve travel for meetings and events.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to: remain in a stationary position 80 % of the time.
Reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities will be provided in accordance with law.
Ability to work with students, staff, and faculty in a collegial environment
Willingness to teach course as currently scheduled (alternative scheduling of a course may be considered depending on applicant availability alongside other course scheduling considerations)

Employee must be able to communicate with others to exchange information including both over the telephone and in-person communication with callers and community members and be able to read a computer screen and paper documents.
